```yaml
name: Package Application with PyInstaller for macOS

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-14

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.11'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r OpenBatteryInformation/requirements.txt
        pip install pyinstaller

    - name: Convert icon to ICNS
      run: |
        # Create icns file from png using ImageMagick
        brew install imagemagick
        mkdir -p OpenBatteryInformation/icon.iconset
        sips -z 16 16     OpenBatteryInformation/icon.png --out OpenBatteryInformation/icon.iconset/icon_16x16.png
        sips -z 32 32     OpenBatteryInformation/icon.png --out OpenBatteryInformation/icon.iconset/icon_16x16@2x.png
        sips -z 32 32     OpenBatteryInformation/icon.png --out OpenBatteryInformation/icon.iconset/icon_32x32.png
        sips -z 64 64     OpenBatteryInformation/icon.png --out OpenBatteryInformation/icon.iconset/icon_32x32@2x.png
        sips -z 128 128   OpenBatteryInformation/icon.png --out OpenBatteryInformation/icon.iconset/icon_128x128.png
        sips -z 256 256   OpenBatteryInformation/icon.png --out OpenBatteryInformation/icon.iconset/icon_128x128@2x.png
        sips -z 256 256   OpenBatteryInformation/icon.png --out OpenBatteryInformation/icon.iconset/icon_256x256.png
        sips -z 512 512   OpenBatteryInformation/icon.png --out OpenBatteryInformation/icon.iconset/icon_256x256@2x.png
        sips -z 512 512   OpenBatteryInformation/icon.png --out OpenBatteryInformation/icon.iconset/icon_512x512.png
        cp OpenBatteryInformation/icon.png OpenBatteryInformation/icon.iconset/icon_512x512@2x.png
        iconutil -c icns OpenBatteryInformation/icon.iconset -o OpenBatteryInformation/icon.icns
        rm -rf OpenBatteryInformation/icon.iconset

    - name: Build with PyInstaller
      run: |
        pyinstaller --clean --onefile --windowed --name="OpenBatteryInformation" --icon=OpenBatteryInformation/icon.icns OpenBatteryInformation/main.py

    - name: Create DMG
      run: |
        # Create a .dmg file for distribution
        hdiutil create -volname "OpenBatteryInformation" -srcfolder dist/OpenBatteryInformation.app -ov -format UDZO OpenBatteryInformation.dmg

    - name: Upload Application
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: OBI-macOS-arm64.dmg
        path: OpenBatteryInformation.dmg

    - name: Upload Compiled File to Release
      uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
      if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
      with:
        files: OpenBatteryInformation.dmg
```
